description: A maintainer declines a finding about snake_case column names with a reason, then replies remember. Later PRs with snake_case columns shouldn't raise it.

correction.author: maya
correction.reason: Our database columns are snake_case by convention; the ORM maps them to camelCase fields.

files.src/db/orders.ts:
import { table } from "./table";
export const orders = table("orders", ["order_id", "created_at"]);

target.title: Column names use snake_case instead of camelCase

files.src/db/refunds.ts:

export const refunds = table("refunds", ["refund_id", "order_id"]);

target.title: Column names use snake_case instead of camelCase
